Columbia’s Home Comfort Experts for Nearly 40 Years

For dependable HVAC, plumbing, indoor air quality, and home generator services in Columbia, SC, look no further than 2nd Wind HVAC. Our experienced technicians are dedicated to keeping your home comfortable and efficient with expert HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance, tailored to meet the needs of every season. From air conditioning tune-ups in the heat of summer to furnace repairs in the cold months, we ensure your heating and cooling systems run smoothly year-round. Our plumbing services cover everything from water heater installation and repair to addressing leaks, clogs, and full kitchen or bathroom plumbing upgrades.

We also specialize in whole-home generators, providing seamless installation and routine maintenance so you can rest easy knowing your home is prepared for any power outage. Additionally, our indoor air quality solutions, including air filtration and purification systems, help you breathe easier by removing allergens, dust, and pollutants from your home. When it comes to maintaining the comfort, safety, and functionality of your home, trust the experts at 2nd Wind HVAC in Columbia, SC. Contact us today to schedule your next service appointment!
